entities.name: St. Anthony of Padua Cathedral, Oberá
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Anthony of Padua Cathedral, also called Oberá Cathedral, is a Catholic cathedral under the advocacy of St. Anthony of Padua, located in the central area of the city of Oberá, in the province of Misiones, in the South American country of Argentina. Built in neo-Gothic style, it was designed by Austrian architect Anton Von Liebe and started to build in 1943.
